title: Rental Line Amount — Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts Claim Rental
content:
**Rental clause.** The rental on a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts claim is the coverage level's rental amount per day times the calendar days from the day of the repair order's diagnosis to the day of its last labor line, both days counted. No more than the coverage level's most rental days per claim are paid.

**Forming the line.**
1. **Days counted.** The days of the rental window are counted with both its first and its last day included. Any days the store gave free are deducted, and the result is never below zero.
2. **Day limit.** Those days are then capped at the coverage level's most rental days per claim, less the rental days already paid on the claim.
3. **Amount.** The line pays the amount per day times the days paid.
4. **Limit and rounding.** The amount is never more than the part of the coverage level's aggregate claim limit the contract has not paid out (claims paid less reversals). It is rounded half up to the cent.

The diagnosis day and the last labor line are read from the repair order's lines in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.

## Worked figures (hypothetical level paying 42.00 a day, at most 6 days per claim)
| Diagnosis day | Last labor line | Days in window | Rental days already paid on the claim | Days paid | Line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 11th | 15th | 5 | 0 | 5 | 210.00 |
| 2nd | 10th | 9 | 0 | 6 | 252.00 |
| 2nd | 10th | 9 | 2 | 4 | 168.00 |
| 2nd | 10th | 9 | 6 | 0 | nothing to pay |

**Limit (hypothetical).** Where only 120.50 of the aggregate limit is unpaid, a line worked at 252.00 pays 120.50.
